sections.title: The three hooks (one finished video per hook: hook + the same body)
sections.md:
| Hook | Line (voiced) | Source | Cold open (pick) |
|---|---|---|---|
| HK1 | I am so mad, and this is exactly why you read the reviews before you buy another foundation. Because I bought this FACELOVE stick that everyone would not stop raving about, and I am going to be returning it. | script (Scene 1 · Cold-Open Hook), verbatim | **A** — her bare, red-cheeked face close to the lens, the FACELOVE carton held up beside it and tapped twice, sticker 'I'm so mad 😡' (her vanity, late afternoon) |
| HK2 | Okay, I need to vent. I finally found a foundation that actually matches my redness, and I am sending it back. Here is why. | written for this build — needs your approval | **A** — screech of tape: her hands tape shut a grey return mailer with the FACELOVE carton inside, then she looks straight up at the lens (her vanity, hands and face) |
| HK3 | Every makeup counter told me nothing would ever match my redness. So why am I returning the one stick that finally did? | written for this build — needs your approval | **A** — over the saleswoman's shoulder at the makeup counter: a bottle held to her red jaw, three wrong swatches, a slow head shake (the department-store makeup counter) |
